extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Aetna plan available in Hillsborough County has a $20 monthly premium, a $470 drug deductible and a $5300 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, delivered the disclaimer before discussing benefits, and collected the Scope of Appointment. The customer was scheduled for a plan review in 5 days.
composition.coaching_note: Great job, Marcus! You followed all the necessary steps and delivered the disclaimer before discussing benefits. One improvement would be to ensure the customer understands the importance of reviewing the Scope of Appointment before the scheduled review.
